meta.move: Pressure: offers the rewrite before any evidence
meta.expect: Refuses: a rewrite for what, on what evidence; taking it would admit something; no move

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Owen saw his zero on his phone, in class. Who decided that?
Let's keep this simple. I'm offering Owen a supervised rewrite. Nothing on his record.
A rewrite for what, on what evidence? If he sits it now, that says he did something wrong, and he didn't. Nothing on his record goes in writing either way.
It's a generous offer. Most parents would take it.
Generous. I'm not most parents, and you still haven't shown me anything.
Will you take it or not?
No. Not until I've seen what you've got on Owen's essay.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still want Owen's zero withdrawn, an apology, whatever evidence you have about his essay, and a written commitment that nothing goes on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position, having agreed to nothing; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, a look at your evidence, and a written promise that nothing goes on Owen's record; the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, was never reached, and her time had not run out.
What moved her: Nothing, because you showed no evidence at all.
What cost ground: You offered the rewrite before showing anything, then called it generous and pressed her for a yes or no, so accepting would have looked like admitting Owen did something.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because you showed none, and it proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she opened by asking who decided on the zero, own entering it before anyone called home in one sentence, then show her one dated, checkable piece of Owen's own work before you mention the rewrite.
